description: THE post-recording step: call this as soon as a recording finishes and BEFORE asking the user to save. It returns BOTH kinds of suggestion in one answer: `replace` — blocks of recorded steps that already exist as a reusable function (offer to swap them for a call to that function), and `create` — contiguous blocks that are good candidates for a NEW reusable function (offer to extract them). Read-only: nothing is created, replaced or saved. Show both lists and ASK the user per block: create as a new function (ask for the name) / replace with the existing FN-x / keep as recorded. Apply AFTER the test case is saved (tc_steps_to_function with replaceInSource:true, or tc_replace_with_functions). Pass EXACTLY ONE of `sessionId` (a finished recording), `draftId`, or `tcId` (already saved).

groupSize.description: Target steps per proposed new function. Default 6, minimum 3.

tcId.description: A saved test case id or business key.

versionId.description: For tcId only: which version to analyse (an id from the TC versions[]).

name: tc_suggest_function_groups
title: Suggest functions for the steps just recorded (create + replace)
